items.title_zhTW: NovaRadar 生醫永續一號基金正式啟動
items.title_en: NovaRadar Bio Sustainability Fund I Officially Launched
items.summary_zhTW: 第一期基金成功募集，規模達新台幣 30 億元，重點布局次世代核酸藥物與 AI 精準篩檢。
items.summary_en: The first fund has been successfully raised, reaching NT$3 billion, with a focus on next-generation nucleic acid therapeutics and AI-driven precision screening.
items.content_zhTW:
瑞大生技投資管理顧問股份有限公司（NovaRadar Bio Venture）宣布，第一期基金「NovaRadar 生醫永續一號基金」正式啟動，本期基金成功募集新台幣 30 億元，重點布局次世代核酸藥物與 AI 精準篩檢兩大領域。

本基金將秉持公司一貫「科學求真、守護生命、永續共榮」的投資理念，鎖定全球具國際競爭力的生技醫療投資標的。
items.content_en:
NovaRadar Bio Venture Corporation announced the official launch of its first fund, the "NovaRadar Bio Sustainability Fund I." The fund successfully raised NT$3 billion, with a strategic focus on two key areas: next-generation nucleic acid therapeutics and AI-driven precision screening.

The fund will continue to uphold the company's guiding philosophy of "scientific rigor, protecting life, sustainable co-prosperity," targeting globally competitive biotech and healthcare investment opportunities.

items.title_zhTW: 瑞大生技投資團隊出席 2026 亞洲生技產業論壇
items.title_en: NovaRadar Investment Team Attends the 2026 Asia Biotech Industry Forum
items.summary_zhTW: 瑞大生技投資團隊受邀出席論壇，分享跨界生醫投資觀點。
items.summary_en: NovaRadar's investment team was invited to speak at the forum, sharing cross-disciplinary perspectives on biomedical investment.
items.content_zhTW: 瑞大生技投資管理顧問投資團隊受邀出席 2026 亞洲生技產業論壇，與國際生技投資機構代表交流，分享公司在新藥研發與精準醫療領域的投資觀點與布局經驗。
items.content_en: NovaRadar Bio Venture's investment team was invited to attend the 2026 Asia Biotech Industry Forum, exchanging insights with representatives from international biotech investment institutions and sharing the company's investment perspective and track record in new drug development and precision medicine.
